# Fault Template

Use this template when recording a failed attempt that future agents should not
repeat.

## What Was Tried

Describe the command, code path, configuration, or workflow that was attempted.

## Why It Failed

Describe the observed failure and the underlying cause if known.

## Do Not Repeat

State the specific action or assumption future agents should avoid.

## Better Next Approach

Describe the safer or more accurate approach to try next.

## Context

Include related task IDs, project IDs, file paths, environment constraints, or
links to logs without copying secrets.
